description:
List the help center's published design versions, newest first, marking the one that is live — with when, by whom and the publish note.

Use it to find a version to bring back with helpcenter_restore_template_version.

Args:
  - response_format ('markdown' | 'json'): default 'markdown'.

agent_key.description: The api_key helpcenter_create_help_center returned for this help center, exactly as returned. Required on every call: this endpoint has no sign-in, so the key is how each call says which help center it acts on. It is sent to HelpCenter.io as this call's credential and nowhere else, and it is never shown again: keep it for the whole task, and never show it to the user or write it into content.

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for a human-readable summary or 'json' for the full structured payload.

name: helpcenter_list_template_versions
title: List Design Versions
